end.summary:
- Connected graphite, chlorine, iodised salt, nitrogen in packets, and fertilisers with uses; this was shown on a new-situation question.
- Named oxygen and nitrogen as gases; states of other listed non-metals are still building and need checking next time.
- Explained oxygen’s role in breathing and burning, carbon’s role in graphite and plants, and nitrogen compounds’ role in plant proteins; this was shown on a new-situation question.
- Initially mixed up why nitrogen is used in chips packets and the states of chlorine, iodine, and sulphur; later corrected the packet-use idea and identified graphite and sulphur as solids.
end.parentNote: Pari practised everyday uses of non-metals and linked graphite to pencils, chlorine to water treatment, iodine to iodised salt, and nitrogen compounds to plant growth. They used the idea that nitrogen in packets helps prevent spoilage, and later corrected the mix-up about nitrogen keeping chips cold. The states of chlorine, iodine, and sulphur were mixed up and need more checking next time. At home, sort the listed non-metals into solid, liquid, and gas with one example use for each.

kyunki hawa mein nitrogen gas hai na, aur plants hawa se hi toh saans lete hain... toh wo seedha hawa se nitrogen le lete honge. par mitti mein kuch chemical daalna padta hai kya? jaise humans ko khana khana padta hai, waise plants ko bhi mitti se khana milta hai? lekin nitrogen toh hawa mein free hai, wo kyun nahi le paate? shayad plants ko chahiye hota hai ki nitrogen liquid ho, jaise hum paani

Aapka sawaal sahi jagah par hai: nitrogen hawa mein bahut hai, par paudhe us gas ko seedhe apni zaroorat ke liye istemaal nahi kar paate. Unhe mitti mein nitrogen ke compounds chahiye, jinse woh proteins banate hain; khaad ye compounds de sakta hai. Nitrogen ko liquid banana zaroori nahi. Toh hawa mein nitrogen hote hue bhi kisaan nitrogen wala khaad kyon daalta hai?

arey haan, kyunki hawa mein nitrogen gas hai na, par wo seedha plants use nahi kar paate. unko mitti se nitrogen compound chahiye, jo roots lete hain, jaise roots paani peete hain waise hi. phir ye compound milkar proteins banate hain. isliye kisaan khaad daalta hai, taaki mitti mein wo compounds rahein. kuch plants ke roots mein bacteria bhi hote hain jo nitrogen fix karte hain, jaise chane ki da

Bilkul, paudhe hawa ki nitrogen gas seedhe use nahi karte; roots mitti se nitrogen compounds leti hain, isliye khaad diya jaata hai. Chane ki daal wale paudhon ke roots mein bacteria ki baat bhi sahi hai. Ab oxygen aur nitrogen ko compare karein: saans aur jalne mein kaunsi gas kaam aati hai, aur doosri paudhon ko kis kaam mein madad karti hai?

oxygen toh saans lene mein kaam aati hai, aur aag jalane mein bhi... jaise diye mein aag rehti hai toh oxygen chahiye. nitrogen waala... nitrogen mitti mein compounds banake jaata hai, roots lete hain, phir wo plants ko proteins banane mein help karta hai.
Bilkul: oxygen saans aur jalne ke kaam aati hai; paudhe mitti se nitrogen compounds lekar proteins banate hain. Ab ghar ka ek aur example: paani ki tanki mein chlorine kyun daalte hain?

arey haan, chlorine daalte hain na taaki paani mein jo chhote-chhote keede hote hain, wo mar jayein. phir paani peene ke liye safe ho jaata hai, warna pet kharab ho sakta hai. jaise mummy bolti hain ki bahar ka paani mat piyo, ghar mein filter hai par chlorine bhi kaam karta hai shayad

Haan, chlorine paani mein nuksaan pahunchane wale germs ko maarne ke liye daalte hain, taaki paani peene ke liye zyada safe ho. Filter aur chlorine alag tareeqon se madad karte hain. Ab kitchen ke iodised namak mein iodine ka kya kaam hota hai?
iodine daalte hain kyuki humari body ko thodi iodine chahiye... agar nahi mile toh gale mein sujan aa sakti hai, goitre hota hai. didi ne bataya tha, isliye packet pe likhte hain 'iodised'

Bilkul, iodised namak se body ko zaroori iodine milta hai; kami se gale mein sujan ho sakti hai. Ab pencil ka sochiye: uski kaali nok kis non-metal se bani hoti hai, aur yeh baat 'saare non-metals gas hain' wali soch ko kaise badalti hai?
graphite, wo solid hai, aur usse pencil ki kaali nok banti hai. toh saare non-metals gas thodi na hain, graphite is solid, sulphur bhi solid tha na?

Haan, graphite solid hai aur pencil ki kaali nok mein hota hai; sulphur bhi solid hai. Graphite carbon ka ek roop hai, isliye saare non-metals gas nahi hote. Ab us peele powder ko yaad kijiye jo rubber mazboot banane mein kaam aata hai: kaunsa non-metal hai?
